Data.String: E-101: two shells in series (D-017, D-024). H-101 fuel: double block and bleed XV-112/XV-125 with vent XV-126, by US-112 (FZ-110, TZ-113, PZ-127: C&E I-101, I-102, I-104); pilots and BMS in the heater package
PSV-119 protects the loop from E-101 inlet through H-101 coil, R-101 and E-101 tube side (no isolation valve between); set and case: S8
FIC-108 set point from PIC-205 (loop pressure, P-02). US-122 closes the toluene feed XV-120 and the make-up H2 XV-121 (C&E I-101, I-102, I-202). LZ-123: C&E I-103. Spec and DN: D-025
